sources.title: Rate Limits and Timeouts — Ramp API docs

identity.description: Ramp is a corporate spend management platform (cards, bill pay, reimbursements, procurement) with a Developer API, MCP server and CLI.
identity.identity_notes: Docs at docs.ramp.com describe the Ramp Developer API for cards, bills, users, accounting.

auth.oauth_flows: Client Credentials, Authorization Code, Refresh Token, and JWT Bearer (ID-JAG) grants; client authenticates via HTTP Basic with client_id:client_secret at /developer/v1/token
auth.token_refresh: Client credentials tokens last 10 days; auth code/refresh access tokens default 1 hour. Refresh token grant must be enabled for the app; client credentials returns no refresh token.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes follow resource:permission pattern (e.g. transactions:read). Some are partner-only; cards:read_vault only for approved integrators. Ramp MCP/CLI use OAuth with Full or Read-only access instead of scopes.

access.production_restrictions: Production write requests are disabled in the docs try-it console (use sandbox). Apps accessing the whole business require an Admin or Business Owner to approve. Some endpoints require a Ramp plan feature (403 otherwise). cards:read_vault only for approved integrators.

api.rate_limits: 200 requests per 10 seconds per source IP; token issuance 100 POST /developer/v1/token per 10 seconds per IP; exceeding returns 429 and may block for 60 seconds. Higher limits by support request.
api.limitations: Some endpoints need a Ramp plan feature; partner-only scopes; transactions synced_after is not an updated-at filter; no updated-at filters on bills/purchase orders.
